stem: The probability that a certain spinner lands on red on any spin is $p$. The spinner is spun 140 times and it lands on red 35 times.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find an approximate 96% confidence interval for $p$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: From three further experiments, Jack finds a 90% confidence interval, a 95% confidence interval and a 99% confidence interval for $p$.
parts.text: Find the probability that exactly two of these confidence intervals contain the true value of $p$.
